description: Implementation of the rx::Query11 class for Direct3D 11 queries in ANGLE, handling query lifecycle, result retrieval, and GPU timing.

classes.name: Query11
classes.description: Implements Direct3D 11 query handling for ANGLE, managing query states, results, and timing.

classes.name: Query11::QueryState
classes.description: Holds the state of an individual query, including timestamps and completion status.

methods.name: MergeQueryResults
methods.description: Merges two query results based on the query type, handling logical OR, addition, or replacement.

methods.name: Query11::Query11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the query with renderer and type.

methods.name: Query11::~Query11
methods.description: Destructor that notifies the renderer to delete the query object.

methods.name: Query11::begin
methods.description: Starts the query, resetting result sum and notifying the state manager.

methods.name: Query11::queryCounter
methods.description: Handles timestamp queries; currently only resets result sum.

methods.name: Query11::getResultBase
methods.description: Retrieves the query result after flushing pending queries.

methods.name: Query11::getResult
methods.description: Overloaded functions to get query results as different types.

methods.name: Query11::isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the query result is available.

methods.name: Query11::pause
methods.description: Pauses the current query, ending the active query and pushing it to pending.

methods.name: Query11::resume
methods.description: Resumes or starts a new query, allocating resources and beginning queries as needed.

methods.name: Query11::flush
methods.description: Processes pending queries, testing for completion and merging results.

methods.name: Query11::testQuery
methods.description: Tests if a query has completed and retrieves its data, updating the result.
